articles.title: Travis Kelce faces growing scrutiny as tax records raise questions about charitable spending and financial transparency
articles.description: Travis Kelce faces scrutiny after an Arizona Republic investigation raised concerns about spending and governance at his Eighty-Seven and Running Foundation. Tax records indicated that only 41 cents of every dollar went towards charitable activities between 2021 and 2024. Kelce’s representatives blamed reporting errors, saying management fees fell to zero in 2025. The foundation also plans to expand its board and improve financial reporting to strengthen transparency and accountability.

articles.title: India Wants Minerals, Canada Wants Markets: The Big Trade Deal Explained
articles.description: India and Canada are pushing to deepen economic ties, with a proposed Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) aiming to raise bilateral trade from C30.4billionin2025toC70 billion by 2030. The negotiations could open opportunities in energy, LNG, critical minerals, aerospace, technology and supply chains. India wants resources and investment to support its manufacturing ambitions, while Canada is looking to expand exports and diversify beyond its heavy dependence on the US market. With negotiations underway and both sides targeting a deal by the end of 2026, the key question is whether these ambitions can translate into real business opportunities.
